documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: An earlier inquiry from our managed services team requested discovery about inconsistent reporting. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for your inquiry. We understand that there may be some conflicting information regarding the project status and requirements. To ensure we align properly and provide the best support, could you please clarify the current status of the project and any specific requirements that are in question?

We're here to help and look forward to your response.
